caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers positioned against a plain, light beige background. The chest is rectangular, constructed of light brown wood, and consists of three different sections on its front side: a broad lid section at the top, two smaller drawers beneath it side by side, and a larger single drawer at the bottom. There are three red, eight-pointed star motifs painted on the front panel, one on each side and one in the center. The metallic hardware on the chest includes ornate handles and keyholes—the handles are affixed to the smaller drawers and the larger drawer at the bottom, and there are also escutcheon plates above the center and bottom drawers. The chest stands on four short feet, each with a slight outward curve. The composition focuses solely on the chest, and there are no additional objects or decorations in the image. The background remains unadorned except for the artist's signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Chest with Drawers
